title: Solid phase silver sulfide nanoparticles contribute significantly to biotic silver in agricultural systems
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1202-1213
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00961D, Paper
Yingnan Huang, Huijun Yan, Fei Dang, Zhenyu Wang, Jason C. White, Yujun Wang
This study presents the first evidence of a substantial contribution of soil-borne NPs to biotic silver burden in comparison to aqueous phase NPs observed in the water column.
